newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks edge higher to fresh record.
newsitem.headline: French stocks edge higher to fresh record.

text.p: Paris shares scraped to a fourth consecutive record close on Monday although they finished well below their session highs.
Traders said foreign funds were entering the market, offsetting some profit-taking on the market's gains.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 0.93 point or 0.03 percent at 2,709.21 after retreating from a session and all-time high of 2,724.42. The CAC-40 futures contract was down two points at 2,715 from Friday's close.
TF1 shares rose 6.54 percent to 570 francs. Societe Generale upgraded the stock to outperform from neutral after TF1 raised its subscription forecast for the TPS digital television service.
Credit Lyonnais certificates fell 5.56 percent to 204 francs on profit-taking on a recent speculative runup on hopes of a fresh government bailout.
Banque Nationale de Paris shares shed 1.82 percent to 264 francs as investors took profits on its gains last week on improved results.
Europe 1 shares fell after the broadcaster told analysts it expected results to stagnate at 70-80 million francs to the end of the decade.
